text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 电影场景第2批 · 17 · 画室里未完成的春天.
Environment:  A modest 19th-century young artist's studio with high north-facing windows, ivory plaster walls, pale aged wood floor and exposed beams. Two easels to left hold unfinished landscapes and botanical studies only, a wooden paint trolley with modest pigments, linen cloth, ceramic pitcher with a few white flowers, one empty plain chair. Tall shelves with canvas backs, open rear door toward a bright interior landing. Art-making traces feel specific and warm, center floor open, fine paint smears and natural dust visible, no portrait art, no statues or anatomical casts.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent elevated three-quarter axonometric cutaway / dollhouse image. Remove roof and selected foreground walls to expose the connected spatial volume, floor levels, entrances, furniture and surroundings. Outdoor locations use an elevated terrain model. Clear layered depth, white presentation margin, no inset pictures.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Create one spatial reference image for 电影场景第2批 · 17 · 画室里未完成的春天. Image1 is exact visual style and scene identity reference. Image2 is the spatial layout authority. Preserve same single location, all door/window/landmark/furniture relationships. Unseen sides may be reconstructed conservatively. One large roofless axonometric 3D dollhouse cutaway of the entire plan, coherent wall heights, all key furnishings and access visible, white page. For outdoors a raised site massing model. No people, animals, human pictures or silhouettes. No invented numbers/dimensions. Preserve original materials, palette and lighting. No added rooms or unrelated locations.
